description: GTEx v8: RAC2 haematopoietic restriction versus ubiquitous RAC1, with tau specificity index and bootstrap CI
code:
import requests, json
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from scipy.stats import mannwhitneyu
S=requests.Session(); S.headers.update({"User-Agent":"openscientist/1.0","Accept":"application/json"})

ids={"RAC1":"ENSG00000136238.17","RAC2":"ENSG00000128340.14","RAC3":"ENSG00000169750.8"}
frames={}
for sym,gid in ids.items():
    r=S.get("https://gtexportal.org/api/v2/expression/medianGeneExpression",
            params={"gencodeId":gid,"datasetId":"gtex_v8","itemsPerPage":100}, timeout=90)
    dd=r.json()["data"]
    frames[sym]=pd.Series({x["tissueSiteDetailId"]: x["median"] for x in dd})
    print(f"{sym}: {len(dd)} tissues")
G=pd.DataFrame(frames).dropna()

def tau(x):
    x=np.asarray(x,float); return ((1-x/x.max()).sum())/(len(x)-1)

print("\nTop 10 tissues by RAC2 median TPM (GTEx v8):")
print(G.sort_values("RAC2",ascending=False).head(10).round(2).to_string())
print("\nBottom 6 tissues:")
print(G.sort_values("RAC2").head(6).round(2).to_string())
print(f"\nRAC2 over {len(G)} tissues: max {G.RAC2.max():.1f} TPM ({G.RAC2.idxmax()}), median {G.RAC2.median():.1f}, min {G.RAC2.min():.2f} ({G.RAC2.idxmin()}), max/min {G.RAC2.max()/G.RAC2.min():.0f}x")
print(f"RAC1 over {len(G)} tissues: max {G.RAC1.max():.1f} ({G.RAC1.idxmax()}), median {G.RAC1.median():.1f}, min {G.RAC1.min():.1f} ({G.RAC1.idxmin()}), max/min {G.RAC1.max()/G.RAC1.min():.1f}x")
for s in ids: print(f"tau {s} = {tau(G[s]):.3f}")

rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
d_obs=tau(G.RAC2)-tau(G.RAC1)
boot=[tau(G.RAC2.values[i])-tau(G.RAC1.values[i]) for i in (rng.integers(0,len(G),(4000,len(G))))]
lo,hi=np.percentile(boot,[2.5,97.5])
print(f"\ntau(RAC2)-tau(RAC1) = {d_obs:.3f}, bootstrap 95% CI [{lo:.3f}, {hi:.3f}]")

blood=[t for t in G.index if any(k in t.lower() for k in ["whole_blood","spleen","lymphocyte","ebv"])]
nonb=G.drop(index=blood)
print("\nhaematopoietic/lymphoid tissues:", blood)
print(G.loc[blood].round(1).to_string())
u,p=mannwhitneyu(G.loc[blood,"RAC2"], nonb["RAC2"], alternative="greater")
u1,p1=mannwhitneyu(G.loc[blood,"RAC1"], nonb["RAC1"], alternative="greater")
print(f"\nRAC2: blood/lymphoid median {G.loc[blood,'RAC2'].median():.1f} vs other {nonb['RAC2'].median():.1f} TPM; U={u:.0f}, p={p:.2e}; ratio {G.loc[blood,'RAC2'].median()/nonb['RAC2'].median():.1f}x")
print(f"RAC1: blood/lymphoid median {G.loc[blood,'RAC1'].median():.1f} vs other {nonb['RAC1'].median():.1f} TPM; U={u1:.0f}, p={p1:.3f}; ratio {G.loc[blood,'RAC1'].median()/nonb['RAC1'].median():.2f}x")

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2, figsize=(15.2,6.6), gridspec_kw={"width_ratios":[1.4,1]})
ax=axes[0]
top=G.sort_values("RAC2",ascending=False).head(20)[::-1]
yp=np.arange(len(top))
ax.barh(yp+0.2, top.RAC2, height=0.4, color="#C03221", label="RAC2")
ax.barh(yp-0.2, top.RAC1, height=0.4, color="#4C78A8", label="RAC1")
ax.set_yticks(yp); ax.set_yticklabels([t.replace("_"," ")[:33] for t in top.index], fontsize=8)
for i,t in enumerate(top.index):
    if t in blood: ax.get_yticklabels()[i].set_color("#C03221"); ax.get_yticklabels()[i].set_weight("bold")
ax.set_xlabel("GTEx v8 median expression (TPM)", fontsize=9.5); ax.legend(fontsize=9, frameon=False, loc="lower right")
ax.set_title(f"A  RAC2 expression is haematopoietic-restricted; RAC1 is ubiquitous\nRAC2 {G.loc[blood,'RAC2'].median():.0f} TPM in blood/lymphoid vs {nonb['RAC2'].median():.1f} TPM elsewhere (Mann-Whitney p = {p:.1e})",
             fontsize=9.8, loc="left", weight="bold")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)

ax=axes[1]
ax.scatter(G.RAC1, G.RAC2, s=26, c="#aaa", alpha=0.7, label="other tissues")
ax.scatter(G.loc[blood,"RAC1"], G.loc[blood,"RAC2"], s=95, c="#C03221", zorder=3, label="blood / lymphoid")
for t in blood: ax.annotate(t.replace("_"," ")[:20], (G.loc[t,"RAC1"],G.loc[t,"RAC2"]), fontsize=7.5, xytext=(6,3), textcoords="offset points", color="#C03221")
mx=G.RAC1.max()*1.05; ax.plot([0,mx],[0,mx], ls="--", color="#ccc", lw=1)
ax.text(mx*0.62, mx*0.68, "RAC2 = RAC1", fontsize=7.5, color="#aaa", rotation=40)
ax.set_xlabel("RAC1 median TPM", fontsize=9.5); ax.set_ylabel("RAC2 median TPM", fontsize=9.5)
ax.set_title(f"B  Tissue-specificity index tau over {len(G)} GTEx tissues\nRAC2 = {tau(G.RAC2):.2f}, RAC1 = {tau(G.RAC1):.2f}\ndifference {d_obs:.2f}, bootstrap 95% CI [{lo:.2f}, {hi:.2f}]",
             fontsize=9.8, loc="left", weight="bold")
ax.legend(fontsize=8.5, frameon=False, loc="upper left")
for s in ["top","right"]: ax.spines[s].set_visible(False)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
